messages:
sam_sales: Quick sync — ACME pilot kickoff. We need to lock scope + cut a simple integration plan by EOD Thu. Top asks from their PM: use cases, eval plan, auth/quotas, streaming support, and a rough cost estimate.
neha_se: I can lead the integration path. Their infra: hybrid cloud, wants server-side calls with short-lived keys. Is VPC required for the pilot?
alex_prod: PM said no full VPC for pilot, but must be able to sign requests with customer-managed keys. Success criteria: P50 latency < 300ms for text-gen under typical prompt, <= 5% hallucination on the evaluation set, cost <= $750 / 100k queries.
lina_cs: We'll also need acceptance criteria on UX — e.g., streaming start within 150ms for first token and no more than 2 reconnections per 10k sessions.
kevin_sec: Security checklist: customer needs SOC2 + KMS support. We can offer envelope encryption (bring-your-own-key) for private deployments. They'll fill out our short questionnaire; I've attached the link: https://redwood.dev/security/questionnaire (they asked for a quick turnaround).
sam_sales: Great. For the eval: they want NLU + slot-filling + creative completion. Can we create a 150-case prompt pack (30 per use case) for them to run?
neha_se: Yes. I'll draft prompts and a small harness. For SDKs, recommend our official Python SDK v0.9 with streaming example. Minimal snippet to share:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")
resp = client.generate("Summarize this doc:")
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
neha_se: For retries — use exponential backoff with jitter, max_retries=5, and idempotency token for not-repeated side-effects. For streaming reconnects we resume with KV cache token if available.
alex_prod: Quotas: propose pilot limits = 500 concurrent requests, token throughput cap 150k tokens/min, per-API-key rate limit 50 reqs/sec. If they need higher, we can set burst capacity after initial run.
lina_cs: Timeline propose: Day 0-2: prompt pack + onboarding keys. Day 3-5: integration test + small load. Day 6-7: run evals + review metrics. Day 10: internal decision call.
sam_sales: Who owns what? neha -> integration guide + SDK sample; lina -> acceptance runner + UX checks; kevin -> security questionnaire; alex -> success metrics & pricing estimate.
kevin_sec: On the questionnaire — note on KMS: for pilot we can support API-key wrapped keys (not full HSM). If they need HSM for production we escalate. Also require a brief pen-test if they want private infra access.
neha_se: Telemetry: add a route tag in headers X-Redwood-Route: acme-pilot and include client-generated request_id for tracing. Example header: {"Authorization": "Bearer <KEY>", "X-Request-ID": "<uuid>", "X-Redwood-Route": "acme-pilot"} (we'll send snippet).
sam_sales: Pricing ballpark for pilot: metered usage + one-off setup. Estimate: ~$600 for expected token usage + $1k integration support. Alex pls confirm final numbers.
alex_prod: Confirmed rough numbers. I'll send a short line-item estimate by EOD.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: pilot-namespace ondedicated-gpu-3 at 2026-03-24T14:00Z (automated).
lina_cs: Small risk note: streaming reconnections in countries with flaky networks—we should highlight resume strategy to the PM.
sam_sales: Perfect. Action items: 1) neha: SDK sample + integration README (due Wed). 2) kevin: questionnaire back to customer (due Wed). 3) alex: pricing & success metric doc (due Thu). 4) lina: eval harness + acceptance runner (due Thu). I'll follow up in sales-ops if anything slips. :thumbsup: 
kevin_sec: I'll also add a short note about token retention policy for pilot sessions.
sam_sales: Thanks all — I'll loop in the ACME PM with a short plan after neha posts the SDK snippet.
neha_se: Posting draft prompts in thread now — will ping when ready. :eyes:
